sections_breakdown.description: Sticky dark crystal glass header with gold trim, logo with skull icon, navigation links, Kingdom badge (1023), sound effect toggle, and CTA 'POSTULER'.

Kinetic Hero with line-by-line masked text reveal. Title: 'GOLDEN PIRATES'. Tagline: 'L'Alliance Souveraine du Royaume 1023 — Call of Dragons'. Status badge: 'PRÉ-KVK / SAISON 2 - RECRUTEMENT OUVERT'. Quick stats grid (Puissance totale, Territoire, Membres, Winrate KvK). CTAs: 'Rejoindre l'Équipage' and 'Vérifier Candidature'.
Slow drift editorial ribbon with low-contrast aged gold text: 'ROYAUME 1023 ☠ GOLDEN PIRATES ☠ CONQUÊTE DU KVK ☠ DISCIPLINE & TERREUR ☠ AUCUNE PITIÉ ☠ FRATERNITÉ D'ACIER ☠ LE BUTIN EST À NOUS'.

Alliance Manifesto section. Narrative scrollytelling with high contrast serif text, background spotlight on ghost ship image, interactive quote from the High Captain, core values (Fraternité, Rigueur Stratégique, Suprématie KvK).

'Le Code des Pirates' — Join Requirements. Interactive cards presenting hard requirements: Puissance Minimum (e.g. 25M+ / T5 priorisés), Présence Discord & Vocal obligatoire lors des Behemoths & War, Troupes T4/T5 requises, Esprit d'équipe & Don d'alliance quotidien, Respect de la hiérarchie de flotte.

Season Timeline horizontal/vertical interactive stepper. Milestones: (1) Saison 1 — Conquête Impériale [Terminée], (2) PRÉ-KVK Saison 2 — Mobilisation & Recrutement [EN COURS], (3) Démarrage KvK Saison 2 — Bataille des Terres Sacrées, (4) Fin de Saison 2 — Prochaine Vague de Recrutement.

4-step recruitment process roadmap: (1) Dépôt de candidature en ligne, (2) Attribution du code de suivi pirate unique, (3) Entretien vocal Discord avec le Capitaine du Recrutement, (4) Intégration dans le Royaume 1023.

Pirate Guild Application Form with real-time validation, parchment input styling, custom select inputs, military troop breakdown sliders/inputs. Fields: Pseudo Call of Dragons, Puissance actuelle (en Millions), Niveau de Mairie, Niveau de Troupes (T4 / T5), Activité quotidienne (Heures/jour), Expérience KvK & Alliances précédentes, Discord Tag, Message de motivation. Generates a unique Tracking Code (e.g. GP-1023-894F) stored in local state/backend.

User Space — Portal to check application status using tracking code. Displays status: 'En cours d'examen par le Conseil des Capitaines', 'Accepté — Convocation Discord', or 'Refusé'. Includes pre-filled quick search button for demo codes.

Admin Space — Password protected management portal (default password: '1023' or 'pirates1023'). Features dashboard with table of submitted applications, filter by status (Toutes, En attente, Approuvées, Rejetées), action buttons to Approve/Reject with custom note, statistics overview, search bar.
Deep naval dark footer with massive display type 'GOLDEN PIRATES 1023', quick links, Discord server link, Call of Dragons fan project disclaimer, copyright, back-to-top button with compass arrow.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace font links in public/index.html to import 'Pirata One', 'Cinzel Decorative', 'IM Fell English', and 'JetBrains Mono'.
2. Maintain dark pirate aesthetic with deep navy/sea black backgrounds (#06090E, #0A0F18), rich antique gold highlights (#D4AF37, #F5D77F), and blood-red accents (#B91C1C).
3. Use `framer-motion` for scroll animations, line-by-line hero text reveal, tab transitions, and modal popups.
4. Ensure Lenis smooth scroll is enabled for liquid smooth scrolling effect.
5. Every single interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, cards, links, admin actions) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute matching the design guidelines.
6. Include mock initial applications in local state/storage so the Admin Space has immediate data to test (e.g. 3-4 candidate profiles with different statuses).
7. Provide sound ambience toggle button in header (simulated audio wave with pirate tavern/sea sound toggle visual feedback).
8. Ensure 100% French language throughout all copy, labels, tooltips, and toasts.
9. Make form submission auto-generate a unique pirate code (e.g. `GP-1023-XXXX`) and display a parchment scroll confirmation modal with copy-to-clipboard button.
10. All components must be responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop screens without text clipping or horizontal overflow.

do_not: DO NOT use generic centered Inter/Roboto typography for headings
DO NOT use raw transparent backgrounds on sticky headers or overlays
DO NOT leave inputs or buttons without explicit hover/focus state styling
do_always: Layer noise and grain textures to ground the pirate aesthetic
Use APCA high-contrast text color combinations (gold or pale parchment over deep navy)
Keep all code in clean modular React components in src/components/
Test responsive layouts down to 360px viewport width
